references.text: God's original command to Moses to make fifty loops on one curtain and fifty loops on the edge of the other curtain, as Exodus 36:12 describes the execution of.
Describes the gold clasps that were to be used together with the loops to fasten the curtains together into one whole.
The immediately preceding verse describing the beginning of the work on the loops for the curtains.
The continuation describing how fifty gold clasps were made to fasten the curtains together using the loops.
The complete instruction for the tabernacle's curtains that provides the context for the work on the loops described in Exodus 36:12.
The complementary part of God's instruction regarding the joining of the curtains, which is fulfilled in the verse.
Explains the overall structure (two groups of five) that the loops in the source verse bind together.
